_comment: Roster of animators Khanimator works with. Captured 29 Oct 2026. Run `python build.py` after editing. Metrics drift — see the dynamic-stats note in README.
_consent: PENDING. Every person listed here must have agreed to appear on a site that advertises paid work. Not yet confirmed for any of the four. The site is noindex until it is.
_privacy: Sasquatch's YouTube bio lists a personal email address and a per-cut rate. Both are deliberately NOT reproduced here — republishing someone's email on a third party's commercial site invites scraping. His channel link is the contact route.
